title: EvidenceReasonCode
description: Canonical reason codes emitted by evidence evaluation in twgt-bridge. Two groups: HELD-producing codes indicate a failure, staleness, or missing-input condition; EVIDENCE_READY-producing codes indicate a passing check. All codes are SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE strings. No code in this enum carries admission authority. A code that reads as positive means only that a specific check passed on a specific head, not that the underlying change is admitted.
